# Security Policy

## Supported status

Aster 0.1 is a reference candidate and is not production-authorized. No released
version currently receives a production security-support commitment.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not report suspected vulnerabilities, credentials, mission data, packet
captures, or deployment details in a public issue. Use GitHub private
vulnerability reporting when it is enabled for the repository. Otherwise,
contact the repository-owning organization's security team through its private
security channel.

Include the affected version or commit, impact, reproduction conditions, and a
minimal non-sensitive proof of concept. Maintainers should acknowledge a report
privately before discussing disclosure timing or remediation publicly.
